summary.text: Lee Filer is a Republican member of the Wyoming House of Representatives from District 44, serving since January 2025, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Lee Filer was born in Cheyenne, Wyoming, and served in the U.S. Air National Guard.
Filer's career experience includes working as a railroad conductor and business owner.
Filer previously represented Wyoming House of Representatives District 12 from 2013 to 2015.
Filer assumed office in District 44 on January 6, 2025, succeeding Tamara Trujillo, and for 2025-2026 committee assignments include the House Judiciary Committee and the Joint Judiciary Committee.
